description: Runs pip list and returns a structured list of installed packages.

exclude.description: Package names to exclude from output

excludeEditable.description: Exclude editable packages from the list (--exclude-editable)

local.description: Only list packages in the local virtualenv (-l, --local)

notRequired.description: List packages that are not dependencies of other packages (--not-required)

outdated.description: Only list outdated packages with their latest available versions (--outdated)

user.description: Only list packages installed in user-site (--user)

name: pip-list

error.description: Parse error message when JSON parsing fails

latestFiletype.description: File type of the latest version (only when outdated=true)

rawOutput.description: Raw CLI output included when parsing fails

total.description: Total installed package count (set in compact output)

truncated.description: Whether the compact package list was capped (only set when true)

title: pip List
